name: Jingmen Mobile Big Data Center
developer: China Mobile Hubei / China Mobile Jingmen
notes: Hubei Daily reported China Mobile Hubei signed with Jingmen to build the Jingmen Mobile big data center; construction was to start in Nov 2022, target early-2025 service, with 2,000 IDC racks for the smart-city brain and local cloud storage needs.

name: Yangtze Economic Data Industrial Park
developer: Beijing Dahua Yichuang Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Jingzhou government investment-promotion notice says the project landed in Jingzhou High-tech Zone with total investment of RMB 3 billion, about 120,000 sqm GFA; phase 1 RMB 1.5 billion for a 3,000-standard-rack big data center, phase 2 another 7,000 racks, plus cloud and big-data platforms.

name: Qianjiang Big Data Center Construction Project
developer: Qianjiang Government Service and Big Data Administration
notes: Qianjiang government work summary says Qianjiang Big Data Center subprojects had completed tender evaluations and were moving to contract signing and construction launch; earlier procurement reporting put the budget around RMB 224 million covering government cloud, data-capability platform, e-government network/security and service systems.

name: Zhuxi Guoxin No. 1 Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Zhuxi County with iFlytek and Huawei support
notes: Science and Technology Daily reported the Guoxin No. 1 intelligent computing center came online in Zhuxi County, Shiyan, using Huawei Ascend hardware and iFlytek Feixing architecture to support local industry models; 26 enterprises signed cooperation at launch.

name: Suixian Mobile Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Local Suizhou report says a Mobile intelligent computing center project landed in Suixian with planned total investment of RMB 203 million and three-phase deployment of 600P hybrid dual-plane compute, positioned as a key digital-economy project.

name: China Mobile Intelligent Computing Center (Wuhan)
notes: Wuhan government reports the China Mobile Wuhan intelligent computing center opened in Jan 2024 and completed phase-2 expansion with total compute over 2,000P by 2025; located around Optics Valley/Future City with additional Chegu node investment planned.

name: China Telecom Central China Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Wuhan government reported China Telecom's Central China intelligent computing center entered operation in Q1 2024; phase 1 provides 200P, phase 2 planned 1,500P and long-range scale 5,000P. China Telecom later described expansions at its Optics Valley base with total compute above 2,000P.

name: Wuchang Intelligent Computing Center at China Telecom Nanhu Facility
notes: Wuhan government reported the Wuchang intelligent computing center, the first center-city intelligent computing center in Wuhan, officially opened on 2024-03-28 in China Telecom's Nanhu facility, with 100P construction scale.

name: Wuhan Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
notes: Wuhan government says Wuhan AI Computing Center had expanded to 400P by Sept 2023 and served more than 300 key enterprises; Huawei source describes it as paired with Wuhan Supercomputing Center.

name: Wuhan Supercomputing Center
developer: Wuhan local government / Huawei ecosystem partners
notes: Huawei case material says Wuhan Supercomputing Center was completed and put into service on 2022-11-23 with roughly 4,400 sqm building area, planned 200P and initial 54P compute, forming a dual compute hub with the Wuhan AI Computing Center.

name: National Cybersecurity Base Intelligent Computing Center
developer: National Cybersecurity Base / H3C and local partners
notes: Wuhan government reported the National Cybersecurity Base intelligent computing center was built in Q1 2024 and was connected to the national supercomputing internet at the Aug 2025 China Computing Power Conference; Wuhan Linkonggang target cited 500P by 2025.

name: Hanjiangwan AI Industrial Park Tencent Cloud Demonstration Computing Center
developer: Wuhan Xinghuo Zhongda Information Technology Co., Ltd. / Tencent Cloud
notes: Wuhan government reported the AI computing center Tencent Cloud demonstration site in Qiaokou's Hanjiangwan AI Industrial Park was in operation, with a second-phase 3,000P compute project already in planning.

name: China Electronics Cloud Trusted Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Wuhan government reported China Electronics Cloud's trusted intelligent computing center had signed to land in Wuhan Economic Development Zone, with expected 2024 operation and 2025 full output.

name: Xiangyang Mobile Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Trade press reported Xiangyang Mobile Intelligent Computing Center officially opened; total planned compute 600PFlops, RMB 200 million early investment, converted from four IDC intelligent-computing rooms at the existing Xiangyang Mobile Cloud Computing Center, with first 200P delivered.

name: Xiangyang Mobile Cloud Computing Center
developer: China Mobile Hubei / China Mobile Xiangyang
notes: China Mobile reported the Xiangyang cloud computing center had been operating for two years by Aug 2017, with 48 customers and 2,800G export bandwidth; Hubei's 14th Five-Year big-data plan lists the Xiangyang cloud-computing base among major data-center projects under accelerated construction.

name: Xianning High-tech Zone Cloud Computing Big Data Center Project
developer: Xianning High-tech Zone investment project; operator not specified
notes: Xianning Investment Promotion Bureau project listing gives total investment of RMB 1 billion for server/storage equipment, technology platform R&D and operations, data-center expansion, cloud storage/cloud-server procurement, and construction of distributed cloud data center and internet basic cloud service platform.
